guidebook.intro: Kozesa **when** ne **if**, era osabe mu bukakamu ne **I would like**.

tips.title: When …
body: **Bwe** (si nga kibuuzo) kiba **when**: **When I wake up, I drink tea.** Ku biseera ebidha, oluvanyuma lwa **when** tokozesa **will**: **When I arrive, I will call you**, si “when I will arrive”.

tips.title: If I had …, I would …
body: **Singa** n’**-andi-** biba **if** ne **would**: **If I had money, I would buy a car.** Oluvanyuma lwa **if** ekikolwa kiba mu byayita: **had**, **were**.

tips.title: “I would like”
body: **I would like** (oba **I’d like**) kiba kisaba kya kitiibwa okusinga **I want**: **I would like tea, please. I would like to go to Jinja.**

culture.title: “Ka tubone”
body: **Ka tubone** kitera okutegeeza “oboolyawo”. Mu Lungereza kiba **Let’s see** oba **We’ll see**, era nakyo kiyinza okuba nga “nedda” mu bukakamu.
